title: Step Functions state types (Task, Choice, Parallel, Map)
hook: AWS Step Functions workflows are graphs of states defined in Amazon States Language (ASL). Task states do the work; Choice branches; Parallel and Map coordinate concurrency. Knowing each state's job is how you read any production state machine.

blocks.text: ASL defines states: Task invokes AWS services or activities; Choice routes on JSONPath conditions; Parallel runs branches concurrently; Map iterates over an array; Wait delays; Pass transforms input; Succeed and Fail terminate. Retry and Catch attach to Task states for resilience and compensation routing.

entries.plainDefinition: State that invokes a resource — Lambda, SNS, SQS, etc.
Conditional branch based on input JSONPath.
Runs a sub-workflow for each item in an array.
Query language to select fields from state input.

blocks.text: Misconfigured JSONPath in Choice sends payments down the wrong branch. Map over 10,000 items without MaxConcurrency throttles Lambda account. Parallel without error handling in each branch leaves partial success uncleaned.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: Task does work, Choice branches, Map iterates, Parallel forks. Retry for transient; Catch for business failure routing.

snippet.label: CLI — start execution and inspect history
snippet.code:
EXEC_ARN=$(aws stepfunctions start-execution \
  --state-machine-arn arn:aws:states:us-east-1:123:stateMachine:orders \
  --input '{"orderId":"ord-1","lineItems":[{"sku":"A"}]}' \
  --query 'executionArn' --output text)

aws stepfunctions get-execution-history \
  --execution-arn "$EXEC_ARN" \
  --reverse-order --max-items 5
snippet.explanation: Execution history shows state entered/exited events — primary debug tool for JSONPath issues.

blocks.title: Step Functions versus async orchestration code
Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: JSONPath $.field vs $.Payload.field after Lambda. Map without MaxConcurrency on large arrays. Catch States.ALL swallowing errors that should fail fast. ResultPath null accidentally discarding input.

blocks.text: How to prove it in production: execution history for failed Choice — compare Variable path to Task output in previous event. Distributed Map for S3 CSV beyond inline Map 256 KB limit. X-Ray traces linked when active tracing enabled on state machine.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Saying 'Map and Parallel are the same.' Strong answer: Parallel runs fixed branches; Map iterates dynamic array with per-item iterator.

interviewTakeaways: Task invokes work; Choice branches on JSONPath; Map iterates arrays; Parallel runs fixed concurrent branches.
ResultPath/ResultSelector shape what the next state sees — debug via execution history.
Retry for transient infra errors; Catch routes to compensation on business failure.
60s: Task work Choice branch Map iterate Parallel fork. JSONPath on Payload wrapper. MaxConcurrency on Map.
Follow-up: when use Distributed Map versus inline Map?
commonPitfalls: Strong answer: inspect execution history output of previous Task state.
Map 50k items inline — hits payload and history limits.
Catch States.ALL hiding programming bugs that should Fail fast.

jsTsCorrelations.note: Parallel state resembles Promise.all on independent branches; Map state resembles Promise.all over array.map with concurrency pool.
XState defines states in code — ASL is infrastructure-as-state-machine with AWS-managed persistence between transitions.
